about: Surviving Stryker mutants of packages/pca-actions justified as equivalent, one entry per mutation site (same format and checker as tools/pca-audit/mutation-equivalents.json; checked with --package=pca-actions --ledger=this file). Every mutant of the audited files that is not listed here is killed by a test.
